title: Carbon dots derived from Averrhoa bilimbi fruit for the detection of cholesterol and chromium(VI)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12132-12140
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00222F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aishwarya Joji Mathew, Varsha Lisa John, P. S. Aiswarya, T. P. Vinod
Carbon dots derived from Averrhoa bilimbi fruit (AB-CDs) were used as a fluoroprobe for the selective detection of cholesterol and Cr(VI) ions. The limits of detection of cholesterol and Cr(VI) were found to be 0.31 µM and 1.71 µM respectively.
